name: Tremors of the Earth
summary: Garek has heard from Sigrun how much you have helped, and asks for your help in turn. Garek's master, Krasus of the Kirin Tor, sent Garek to stop whatever is brewing in Lethlor Ravine, and first a stolen Sign of the Earth must be found.

sections.title: A Matter Kept Close
sections.body: Garek was sent to the Badlands by Krasus of the Kirin Tor, Garek's master, to stop the trouble that is brewing in Lethlor Ravine. The exact assignment cannot be shared, only that it matters greatly. A band of roving ogres, now and then spotted around Camp Boff, took the Sign of the Earth, and Garek needs it. Bring it back and there will be more to learn.

sections.title: The Wandering Ogres
sections.body: The ogres move from camp to camp across the Badlands, and rising heat and swirling winds make their trail hard to follow. Garek has heard they sometimes pass through Camp Boff, a fair place to look if you lose track of them.

sections.title: Garek Explains
sections.body: When you return with the Sign, Garek tells you that Dark Iron dwarves of Angor Fortress made it in order to bind Deathwing's twin lieutenants, the ruthless Blacklash and Hematus.

faq.answer: Garek's master is Krasus of the Kirin Tor, who sent Garek to the Badlands to stop the trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine.

faq.q: What is the Sign of the Earth?
aliases: what is the sign of the earth
faq.answer: Wandering ogres stole it and Garek needs it back. Garek will say more once you bring it.

faq.q: Where can the wandering ogres be found?
aliases: where is sign of the earth
faq.answer: They roam between their camps across the Badlands, and Garek has heard they sometimes pass through Camp Boff.

faq.q: Why does Garek keep the assignment secret?
faq.answer: Garek will not say what the assignment is or what work it calls for, only that it is vitally important.
